description: Chain-of-Thought reasoning benchmark. A GPT-2-style model performs multi-step reasoning: 3 CoT steps (each generating tokens) followed by a final answer generation. Measures end-to-end latency and tokens/sec for multi-step inference.

scaling_param.name: total_generated
scaling_param.description: Total number of tokens generated across all CoT steps plus the answer (3 x cot_step_tokens + answer_tokens)

non_scaling_params.name: prompt_len
non_scaling_params.description: Length of the initial prompt in tokens
